📊 GitHub Copilot – Unified Reference Guide

🔧 FILTERS & SLICERS (HOW TO EXPLORE THE DATA)
🔧
Page-Level Slicers
Filters — affect ALL visuals on the page
Note: Slicers update all visuals on the page simultaneously.
SlicerFieldWhat it filters
TeamDimSeat[teamName]Filters all metrics to a specific GitHub team. Uses the Many-to-Many relationship between users and their team memberships.
IDEvGitHub_MetricUsers[IDE]Filters by coding editor (e.g. vscode, visualstudio, intellij).
LanguagevGitHub_MetricUsers[Language_Main]Filters by the primary programming language used in a session.
Date RangevGitHub_MetricUsers[FilterDate]Limits data to a specific date window.
📌 Metric Cards (top summary numbers)
👤
Total Users
Card Visual
Note: Unique users in the Copilot dataset for the selected period.
Total Users
DISTINCTCOUNT('vGitHub_MetricUsers'[UserLogin])
✅
Active Users
Card Visual
Note: Users with Copilot activity in the last 90 days (GitHub's standard active-seat definition).
Active Seats
VAR CutoffDate = TODAY() - 90 RETURN COUNTROWS( FILTER( VALUES('vGitHub_MetricUsers'[UserLogin]), NOT ISBLANK('vGitHub_MetricUsers'[UserLogin]) && CALCULATE( MAXX( 'vGitHub_MetricUsers', DATEVALUE(LEFT('vGitHub_MetricUsers'[LastActivityAt], 10)) ) ) >= CutoffDate ) )
📈
Adoption Rate
Card Visual
Note: Share of licensed users who are actively using Copilot.
Adoption Rate
DIVIDE([Active Seats], [Total Users])
📊 Line / Area Charts
📊
Acceptance Rate
Area Line Chart – over time
Note: Two lines: Acceptance Rate (prompts) and Acceptance Lines Rate (estimated lines) over time.
AxisField / Measure
X-axis (date)vGitHub_MetricUsers[FilterDate]
Y-axis series 1Acceptance Rate (%)
Y-axis series 2Acceptance Lines Rate (%)
Acceptance Rate (%)
DIVIDE( [Total Acceptances], [Total Suggestions], 0 )
Acceptance Lines Rate (%)
DIVIDE( [Total Lines Accepted], [Total Lines Suggested], 0 )
👤
Active Users
Bar / Column Chart – over time
Note: Daily bars: Active Users (any activity) vs Engaged Users (received ≥1 suggestion).
AxisField / Measure
X-axis (date)vGitHub_MetricUsers[FilterDate]
Y-axis series 1Total Active Users (all users with any Copilot activity)
Y-axis series 2Total Engaged Users (subset with suggestions)
Total Active Users
DISTINCTCOUNT('vGitHub_MetricUsers'[UserLogin])
Total Engaged Users
CALCULATE( DISTINCTCOUNT('vGitHub_MetricUsers'[UserLogin]), 'vGitHub_MetricUsers'[CodeGenerationCount] > 0 )
📝
Total Code Lines Suggestions and Acceptances
Area Line Chart – over time
Note: Lines Suggested vs estimated Lines Accepted over time. Gap = dismissed lines.
AxisField / Measure
X-axis (date)vGitHub_MetricUsers[FilterDate]
Y-axis series 1 (larger)Total Lines Suggested
Y-axis series 2 (smaller)Total Lines Accepted
Total Lines Suggested
VAR HasAnyRows = NOT ISEMPTY(CALCULATETABLE('vGitHub_MetricUsers')) VAR Result = CALCULATE( SUM('vGitHub_MetricUsers'[LocSuggestedToAdd]), KEEPFILTERS(NOT(ISBLANK('DimSeat'[assigneeLogin]))), KEEPFILTERS(NOT(ISBLANK('DimSeat'[teamName]))), KEEPFILTERS(NOT(ISBLANK('vGitHub_MetricUsers'[IDE])))) RETURN IF(HasAnyRows, COALESCE(Result, 0), BLANK())
Total Lines Accepted (estimated)
VAR HasAnyRows = NOT ISEMPTY(CALCULATETABLE('vGitHub_MetricUsers')) VAR ValidMetrics = CALCULATETABLE( 'vGitHub_MetricUsers', KEEPFILTERS(NOT(ISBLANK('DimSeat'[assigneeLogin]))), KEEPFILTERS(NOT(ISBLANK('DimSeat'[teamName]))), KEEPFILTERS('vGitHub_MetricUsers'[IDE] <> BLANK()) ) VAR TotalSuggested = SUMX(ValidMetrics, 'vGitHub_MetricUsers'[LocSuggestedToAdd]) VAR TotalAccCount = SUMX(ValidMetrics, 'vGitHub_MetricUsers'[CodeAcceptanceCount]) VAR TotalGenCount = SUMX(ValidMetrics, 'vGitHub_MetricUsers'[CodeGenerationCount]) VAR FinalResult = ROUND(DIVIDE(TotalSuggested * TotalAccCount, TotalGenCount, 0), 0) RETURN IF(HasAnyRows, COALESCE(FinalResult, 0), BLANK())
💡
Total Code Suggestions and Acceptance
Area Line Chart – over time
Note: Suggestion count (pop-ups shown) vs Acceptances (Tab key) over time.
AxisField / Measure
X-axis (date)vGitHub_MetricUsers[FilterDate]
Y-axis series 1 (larger)Total Suggestions
Y-axis series 2 (smaller)Total Acceptances
Total Suggestions
VAR HasAnyRows = NOT ISEMPTY(CALCULATETABLE('vGitHub_MetricUsers')) VAR ValidMetrics = CALCULATETABLE( 'vGitHub_MetricUsers', KEEPFILTERS(NOT(ISBLANK('DimSeat'[assigneeLogin]))), KEEPFILTERS(NOT(ISBLANK('DimSeat'[teamName]))), KEEPFILTERS('vGitHub_MetricUsers'[IDE] <> BLANK()) ) VAR Result = SUMX(ValidMetrics, 'vGitHub_MetricUsers'[CodeGenerationCount]) RETURN IF(HasAnyRows, COALESCE(Result, 0), BLANK())
Total Acceptances
VAR HasAnyRows = NOT ISEMPTY(CALCULATETABLE('vGitHub_MetricUsers')) VAR ValidMetrics = CALCULATETABLE( 'vGitHub_MetricUsers', KEEPFILTERS(NOT(ISBLANK('DimSeat'[assigneeLogin]))), KEEPFILTERS(NOT(ISBLANK('DimSeat'[teamName]))), KEEPFILTERS('vGitHub_MetricUsers'[IDE] <> BLANK()) ) VAR Result = SUMX(ValidMetrics, 'vGitHub_MetricUsers'[CodeAcceptanceCount]) RETURN IF(HasAnyRows, COALESCE(Result, 0), BLANK())
🍩 Donut Charts
📊
Language
Donut Chart – Percentage of sessions per Language
Note: Session share per language (slices sum to 100%).
AxisField / Measure
Legend (slices)vGitHub_MetricUsers[Language_Main]
Values (slice size)Language Chart
Language Chart
VAR TotalRows = CALCULATE( COUNTROWS('vGitHub_MetricUsers'), ALL('vGitHub_MetricUsers'[Language_Main]), NOT ISBLANK('vGitHub_MetricUsers'[Language_Main]) ) VAR CurrentRows = COUNTROWS('vGitHub_MetricUsers') RETURN IF( ISBLANK(CurrentRows) || CurrentRows = 0 || ISBLANK(TotalRows) || TotalRows = 0, BLANK(), VAR Scale = 10000 VAR CurrentLang = SELECTEDVALUE('vGitHub_MetricUsers'[Language_Main]) VAR CurrentScaled = DIVIDE(CurrentRows * Scale, TotalRows, 0) VAR CurrentFloor = TRUNC(CurrentScaled) VAR CurrentRemainder = CurrentScaled - CurrentFloor VAR AllLangs = FILTER( CALCULATETABLE( ADDCOLUMNS( VALUES('vGitHub_MetricUsers'[Language_Main]), "@Rows", CALCULATE(COUNTROWS('vGitHub_MetricUsers')), "@Floor", TRUNC(DIVIDE(CALCULATE(COUNTROWS('vGitHub_MetricUsers')) * Scale, TotalRows, 0)), "@Rem", DIVIDE(CALCULATE(COUNTROWS('vGitHub_MetricUsers')) * Scale, TotalRows, 0) - TRUNC(DIVIDE(CALCULATE(COUNTROWS('vGitHub_MetricUsers')) * Scale, TotalRows, 0)) ), ALL('vGitHub_MetricUsers'[Language_Main]), NOT ISBLANK('vGitHub_MetricUsers'[Language_Main]) ), [@Rows] > 0 ) VAR TotalFloor = SUMX(AllLangs, [@Floor]) VAR LeftOver = Scale - TotalFloor VAR HigherRemainder = COUNTROWS(FILTER(AllLangs, [@Rem] > CurrentRemainder)) VAR TiesBefore = COUNTROWS(FILTER(AllLangs, [@Rem] = CurrentRemainder && 'vGitHub_MetricUsers'[Language_Main] < CurrentLang )) VAR MyRank = HigherRemainder + TiesBefore + 1 VAR GetsBonus = IF(MyRank <= LeftOver, 1, 0) RETURN DIVIDE(CurrentFloor + GetsBonus, Scale, 0) )
💻
Editor
Donut Chart – Percentage of sessions per IDE
Note: Session share per IDE/editor (slices sum to 100%).
AxisField / Measure
Legend (slices)vGitHub_MetricUsers[IDE]
Values (slice size)IDE Chart
IDE Chart
VAR TotalRows = CALCULATE( COUNTROWS('vGitHub_MetricUsers'), ALL('vGitHub_MetricUsers'[IDE]), NOT ISBLANK('vGitHub_MetricUsers'[IDE]) ) VAR CurrentRows = COUNTROWS('vGitHub_MetricUsers') RETURN IF( ISBLANK(CurrentRows) || CurrentRows = 0 || ISBLANK(TotalRows) || TotalRows = 0, BLANK(), VAR Scale = 10000 VAR CurrentIDE = SELECTEDVALUE('vGitHub_MetricUsers'[IDE]) VAR CurrentScaled = DIVIDE(CurrentRows * Scale, TotalRows, 0) VAR CurrentFloor = TRUNC(CurrentScaled) VAR CurrentRemainder = CurrentScaled - CurrentFloor VAR AllIDEs = FILTER( CALCULATETABLE( ADDCOLUMNS( VALUES('vGitHub_MetricUsers'[IDE]), "@Rows", CALCULATE(COUNTROWS('vGitHub_MetricUsers')), "@Floor", TRUNC(DIVIDE(CALCULATE(COUNTROWS('vGitHub_MetricUsers')) * Scale, TotalRows, 0)), "@Rem", DIVIDE(CALCULATE(COUNTROWS('vGitHub_MetricUsers')) * Scale, TotalRows, 0) - TRUNC(DIVIDE(CALCULATE(COUNTROWS('vGitHub_MetricUsers')) * Scale, TotalRows, 0)) ), ALL('vGitHub_MetricUsers'[IDE]), NOT ISBLANK('vGitHub_MetricUsers'[IDE]) ), [@Rows] > 0 ) VAR TotalFloor = SUMX(AllIDEs, [@Floor]) VAR LeftOver = Scale - TotalFloor VAR HigherRemainder = COUNTROWS(FILTER(AllIDEs, [@Rem] > CurrentRemainder)) VAR TiesBefore = COUNTROWS(FILTER(AllIDEs, [@Rem] = CurrentRemainder && 'vGitHub_MetricUsers'[IDE] < CurrentIDE )) VAR MyRank = HigherRemainder + TiesBefore + 1 VAR GetsBonus = IF(MyRank <= LeftOver, 1, 0) RETURN DIVIDE(CurrentFloor + GetsBonus, Scale, 0) )
📍
Current Timeframe Message
Card Visual — dynamic text label
CurrentDateRangeMessage
VAR MinMetrics = CALCULATE( MIN('vGitHub_MetricUsers'[FilterDate]) ) VAR MaxMetrics = CALCULATE( MAX('vGitHub_MetricUsers'[FilterDate]) ) VAR IsSlicingByTeam = ISFILTERED('DimSeat'[teamSlug]) || ISFILTERED('DimSeat'[teamName]) VAR FinalMin = DATE(YEAR(MinMetrics), MONTH(MinMetrics), DAY(MinMetrics)) VAR FinalMax = DATE(YEAR(MaxMetrics), MONTH(MaxMetrics), DAY(MaxMetrics)) VAR SelectedTeam = IF(IsSlicingByTeam, " | Team: " & CONCATENATEX(VALUES('DimSeat'[teamName]), 'DimSeat'[teamName], ", "), "") RETURN IF( ISBLANK(MinMetrics), "🚀 Current Timeframe: No Data Available", "🚀 Current Timeframe: Data spans from " & FORMAT(FinalMin, "MMMM dd, yyyy") & " to " & FORMAT(FinalMax, "MMMM dd, yyyy") & SelectedTeam )

Last Refresh Date
Card Visual — dataset refresh timestamp
Refresh Date (UTC)
"Last refresh date (UTC):" & UNICHAR(10) & FORMAT( SELECTEDVALUE(LastRefreshDate[Refresh_Time_UTC]), "M/D/YYYY h:mm:ss AM/PM" )
🔧 Filters & Slicers (how to explore the data)
🔧
Page-Level Slicers
Filters — affect ALL visuals on the page
Note: Slicers update all visuals on the page simultaneously.
SlicerFieldWhat it filters
TeamDimSeat[teamName]Limits all metrics to users belonging to a specific GitHub team. Uses the Many-to-Many join between users and team memberships.
IDEvGitHub_MetricUsers[IDE]Filters by coding editor (e.g. vscode, visualstudio, intellij).
LanguagevGitHub_MetricUsers[Language_Main]Filters by the primary programming language used in each session.
Time IntervalTime Interval tableSwitches the date grouping (Daily / Weekly / Monthly) for time-based charts.
Date RangevGitHub_MetricUsers[FilterDate]Limits data to a specific date window using a between-date slicer.
📌 Metric Card
🌍
Number of Languages
Card Visual
Note: Distinct active languages in the selected period; blanks excluded.
Total Languages
CALCULATE( DISTINCTCOUNT('vGitHub_MetricUsers'[Language_Main]), KEEPFILTERS( FILTER( ALLSELECTED('vGitHub_MetricUsers'[Language_Main]), VAR FirstChar = LEFT('vGitHub_MetricUsers'[Language_Main], 1) RETURN ((FirstChar >= "a" && FirstChar <= "z") || (FirstChar >= "A" && FirstChar <= "Z") || (FirstChar >= "0" && FirstChar <= "9")) && 'vGitHub_MetricUsers'[Language_Main] <> "others" ) ) )

📋 Language Breakdown Table
📋
Language Breakdown Table
Matrix / Table Visual — one row per Language
Note: Per-language breakdown. Click headers to sort; use the Language slicer to filter.
ColumnMeasure / FieldWhat it shows
Language NamevGitHub_MetricUsers[Language_Main]The primary programming language for that group of sessions.
Accepted PromptsTotal AcceptancesNumber of Copilot suggestion prompts the user accepted (pressed Tab / accepted) across all sessions in this language.
Suggested PromptsTotal SuggestionsTotal number of Copilot suggestion prompts shown to users in this language.
Total Lines AcceptedTotal Lines AcceptedEstimated lines of code accepted. Calculated as Lines Suggested × Acceptance Rate (see note below).
Total Lines SuggestedTotal Lines SuggestedSum of LocSuggestedToAdd — the raw line count Copilot suggested across all sessions.
Acceptance Rate (%)Acceptance Rate (%)Prompt-level acceptance rate: Accepted Prompts ÷ Suggested Prompts.
Acceptance Lines Rate (%)Acceptance Lines Rate (%)Line-level acceptance rate: Total Lines Accepted (estimated) ÷ Total Lines Suggested.
⚙️ Table Column Measures — DAX Detail
📝
Suggestions & Acceptances (Prompt-level)
Volume measures
Note: Raw event counts: suggestions offered and acceptances received — basis for Acceptance Rate.
Total Suggestions
VAR HasAnyRows = NOT ISEMPTY(CALCULATETABLE('vGitHub_MetricUsers')) VAR ValidMetrics = CALCULATETABLE( 'vGitHub_MetricUsers', KEEPFILTERS(NOT(ISBLANK('DimSeat'[assigneeLogin]))), KEEPFILTERS(NOT(ISBLANK('DimSeat'[teamName]))), KEEPFILTERS('vGitHub_MetricUsers'[IDE] <> BLANK()) ) VAR Result = SUMX(ValidMetrics, 'vGitHub_MetricUsers'[CodeGenerationCount]) RETURN IF(HasAnyRows, COALESCE(Result, 0), BLANK())
Total Acceptances
VAR HasAnyRows = NOT ISEMPTY(CALCULATETABLE('vGitHub_MetricUsers')) VAR ValidMetrics = CALCULATETABLE( 'vGitHub_MetricUsers', KEEPFILTERS(NOT(ISBLANK('DimSeat'[assigneeLogin]))), KEEPFILTERS(NOT(ISBLANK('DimSeat'[teamName]))), KEEPFILTERS('vGitHub_MetricUsers'[IDE] <> BLANK()) ) VAR Result = SUMX(ValidMetrics, 'vGitHub_MetricUsers'[CodeAcceptanceCount]) RETURN IF(HasAnyRows, COALESCE(Result, 0), BLANK())
Acceptance Rate (%)
DIVIDE( [Total Acceptances], [Total Suggestions], 0 )
📏
Lines Suggested & Accepted (Line-level)
Volume measures
Note: Line-level volumes. Lines Accepted estimated as ROUND(Suggested × AccCount / GenCount); GitHub API has no direct counter.
Total Lines Suggested
VAR HasAnyRows = NOT ISEMPTY(CALCULATETABLE('vGitHub_MetricUsers')) VAR Result = CALCULATE( SUM('vGitHub_MetricUsers'[LocSuggestedToAdd]), KEEPFILTERS(NOT(ISBLANK('DimSeat'[assigneeLogin]))), KEEPFILTERS(NOT(ISBLANK('DimSeat'[teamName]))), KEEPFILTERS(NOT(ISBLANK('vGitHub_MetricUsers'[IDE])))) RETURN IF(HasAnyRows, COALESCE(Result, 0), BLANK())
Total Lines Accepted (estimated)
VAR HasAnyRows = NOT ISEMPTY(CALCULATETABLE('vGitHub_MetricUsers')) VAR ValidMetrics = CALCULATETABLE( 'vGitHub_MetricUsers', KEEPFILTERS(NOT(ISBLANK('DimSeat'[assigneeLogin]))), KEEPFILTERS(NOT(ISBLANK('DimSeat'[teamName]))), KEEPFILTERS('vGitHub_MetricUsers'[IDE] <> BLANK()) ) VAR TotalSuggested = SUMX(ValidMetrics, 'vGitHub_MetricUsers'[LocSuggestedToAdd]) VAR TotalAccCount = SUMX(ValidMetrics, 'vGitHub_MetricUsers'[CodeAcceptanceCount]) VAR TotalGenCount = SUMX(ValidMetrics, 'vGitHub_MetricUsers'[CodeGenerationCount]) VAR FinalResult = ROUND(DIVIDE(TotalSuggested * TotalAccCount, TotalGenCount, 0), 0) RETURN IF(HasAnyRows, COALESCE(FinalResult, 0), BLANK())
Acceptance Lines Rate (%)
DIVIDE( [Total Lines Accepted], [Total Lines Suggested], 0 )

🔧 FILTERS & SLICERS (HOW TO EXPLORE THE DATA)
🔧
Page-Level Slicers
Filters — affect ALL visuals on the page
SlicerFieldWhat it filters
TeamDimSeat[teamName]Filters all metrics to a specific GitHub team.
CIO / Non-CIOTeam Type[TeamType]Filters between CIO-aligned and Non-CIO business units. Linked via DimSeat[teamName] → Team Type[teamName].
User LoginvGitHub_MetricUsers[UserLogin]Filters all visuals to a single GitHub user. Uses the Many-to-Many join between DimUser and vGitHub_MetricUsers so selecting a name instantly scopes all metrics to that person.
IDEvGitHub_MetricUsers[IDE]Filters by coding editor (e.g. vscode, visualstudio, intellij).
LanguagevGitHub_MetricUsers[Language_Main]Filters by the primary programming language used in a session.
Date RangevGitHub_MetricUsers[FilterDate]Limits data to a specific date window.

👤 User Details
📋
User Details Table
Table Visual — one row per user
Note: Per-user activity attributes. Use the User Login slicer to drill into one person.
ColumnSource FieldWhat it shows
NameDimUser[name]Display name of the GitHub user (friendlier than the raw login).
User LoginvGitHub_MetricUsers[UserLogin]Raw GitHub username — the join key between DimUser and the metrics table.
TeamDimSeat[teamName]GitHub team the user belongs to.
License TypeDimSeat[licenseType]Type of Copilot licence assigned (e.g. business, enterprise).
LanguagevGitHub_MetricUsers[Language_Main]Primary programming language used in the session.
IDEvGitHub_MetricUsers[IDE]Code editor the user was working in.
ModelvGitHub_MetricUsers[Model_Main]Primary AI model used in the session.
FeaturevGitHub_MetricUsers[Feature_Main]Primary Copilot feature used (e.g. code_completion, chat_panel_agent_mode).

VAR TotalRows = CALCULATE( COUNTROWS('vGitHub_MetricUsers'), ALL('vGitHub_MetricUsers'[IDE]), NOT ISBLANK('vGitHub_MetricUsers'[IDE]) ) VAR CurrentRows = COUNTROWS('vGitHub_MetricUsers') RETURN IF( ISBLANK(CurrentRows) || CurrentRows = 0 || ISBLANK(TotalRows) || TotalRows = 0, BLANK(), VAR Scale = 10000 VAR CurrentIDE = SELECTEDVALUE('vGitHub_MetricUsers'[IDE]) VAR CurrentScaled = DIVIDE(CurrentRows * Scale, TotalRows, 0) VAR CurrentFloor = TRUNC(CurrentScaled) VAR CurrentRemainder = CurrentScaled - CurrentFloor VAR AllIDEs = FILTER( CALCULATETABLE( ADDCOLUMNS( VALUES('vGitHub_MetricUsers'[IDE]), "@Rows", CALCULATE(COUNTROWS('vGitHub_MetricUsers')), "@Floor", TRUNC(DIVIDE(CALCULATE(COUNTROWS('vGitHub_MetricUsers')) * Scale, TotalRows, 0)), "@Rem", DIVIDE(CALCULATE(COUNTROWS('vGitHub_MetricUsers')) * Scale, TotalRows, 0) - TRUNC(DIVIDE(CALCULATE(COUNTROWS('vGitHub_MetricUsers')) * Scale, TotalRows, 0)) ), ALL('vGitHub_MetricUsers'[IDE]), NOT ISBLANK('vGitHub_MetricUsers'[IDE]) ), [@Rows] > 0 ) VAR TotalFloor = SUMX(AllIDEs, [@Floor]) VAR LeftOver = Scale - TotalFloor VAR HigherRemainder = COUNTROWS(FILTER(AllIDEs, [@Rem] > CurrentRemainder)) VAR TiesBefore = COUNTROWS(FILTER(AllIDEs, [@Rem] = CurrentRemainder && 'vGitHub_MetricUsers'[IDE] < CurrentIDE )) VAR MyRank = HigherRemainder + TiesBefore + 1 VAR GetsBonus = IF(MyRank <= LeftOver, 1, 0) RETURN DIVIDE(CurrentFloor + GetsBonus, Scale, 0) )

VAR MinMetrics = CALCULATE( MIN('vGitHub_MetricUsers'[FilterDate]) ) VAR MaxMetrics = CALCULATE( MAX('vGitHub_MetricUsers'[FilterDate]) ) VAR IsSlicingByTeam = ISFILTERED('DimSeat'[teamSlug]) || ISFILTERED('DimSeat'[teamName]) VAR FinalMin = DATE(YEAR(MinMetrics), MONTH(MinMetrics), DAY(MinMetrics)) VAR FinalMax = DATE(YEAR(MaxMetrics), MONTH(MaxMetrics), DAY(MaxMetrics)) VAR SelectedTeam = IF(IsSlicingByTeam, " | Team: " & CONCATENATEX(VALUES('DimSeat'[teamName]), 'DimSeat'[teamName], ", "), "") RETURN IF( ISBLANK(MinMetrics), "🚀 Current Timeframe: No Data Available", "🚀 Current Timeframe: Data spans from " & FORMAT(FinalMin, "MMMM dd, yyyy") & " to " & FORMAT(FinalMax, "MMMM dd, yyyy") & SelectedTeam )
